payload.comment: Profiling is complete and internally consistent. All deterministic checks pass: loaded split sizes match official sizes exactly (89996/10004/7180), zero duplicates, zero blank images, full provenance (SHA-256 per split + archive MD5), and 100% of samples profiled.
